limitations: Three steady samples per family are diagnostic coverage, not a new latency SLA or PERF-13 matched regression acceptance.
Acquire includes connection/TLS and queue time; its sum can overlap other query work in the same request.
Query elapsed includes network/server/locks/client queue; overlapping command times can exceed HTTP wall time.
Lock-command RTT is a subset of query RTT, not pure lock wait. Database snapshots are not request-exclusive and can miss brief waits.
Pool maxima observe one touched pool at acquisition points, not aggregate or continuous gauges. maxWaiting can capture transient dispatch.
Event-loop maximum is process-wide since middleware creation, not request CPU or request-exclusive delay.
EXPLAIN execution timings describe fixed SELECT 1, not business SQL. Catalog non-DB residual is not assigned wholesale to Storage.
Full raw/diagnostic pool comparison uses separate connections; shared-pool comparison measures aggregation over an installed inactive proxy. Neither is a causal route-speedup claim.
Both paired HTTP apps share one process with the event-loop monitor installed; its process-wide cost is not isolated by their on/off differences.
Assigned Staff event-window coverage remains the preserved PERF-02 receipt; no fake clock or new fixture is used here.
Provider DB region confirmation and the APAC experiment remain PERF-04; global deadlines remain off and production remains NO_GO.
